glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 辛 + semantic 斤 — to chop wood. Original form of 薪 (“firewood”). The character was later borrowed to represent 新 (“new”) as an instance of jiajie (假借 phonetic loan). A semantic 木 was later added in the bronze inscriptions which merged with the 辛. Shuowen misinterprets the character as 𣓀 + 斤.
shuowen: Shuowen misinterprets the character as 𣓀 + 斤.
